trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops. Everything is single-player: no online trophies, no DLC trophies, no difficulty settings, and one playthrough is enough. Expect around 200 hours (PowerPyx) or 250-300+ (Push Square) — most of it is the 100% checklist for A Long Road. Keep cheats off your trophy run: they disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. The 100% checklist opens after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress you made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion. Required in full: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. The rest only needs a share: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans. Work on it alongside the other trophies and most of it fills itself in.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up. The optional challenge on each stunt is not required — performing it once counts as completed. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map (Exploration > Stunt Spots). The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands. Only certain questlines count — confirmed so far: Kirk (the Skunk Ape strand), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars delivered in good condition pay more. trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring your partner. Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE — the only possibly-missable trophy in the game: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1. One morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and she shows you how it works. That meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked. Do it the moment it appears; it takes a minute and removes the risk. The last spot needs both characters together, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting strand is Jason-only and starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and the first quest, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on his first quest (retrieve it from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation). A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal exactly triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed — completing all 15 Target Decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, should cover it.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters can roam together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. A fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters (they struggle on the tracks and the helicopter can't see you). Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often pops there on its own.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob 3 shops in a row while you stay wanted (the flashing red-and-blue level, not the red heat level). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together and work well. Rob a few items in each store and break the safe with sticky bombs if you can. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it doesn't appear, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning them with the WAiNK app counts; you don't need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic (hold Up to open WAiNK, then R1 to scan). There are 557 vehicles at launch. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this trophy comes on the way. Check your totals in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink, or wash up at home — and take Adrenaline to stretch it longer. Line up 5 enemies, use an assault rifle (the Duke 556 is accurate and full-auto), and don't miss. Gang operation thugs work well; police, soldiers and civilians don't seem to count. It gets easier as your Focus levels up (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing all raise it), and it may pop naturally late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport — planes parked out on the airfield don't count. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence, use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, back the plane out, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand at the south end of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies from inside the tank until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3), which gives you the Snap Gun for silently opening alarmed doors. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking the door in trips the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, empty the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, all without being spotted. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (it marks itself from story progress and walks you through the first one). Follow a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — the haul is too heavy for one character, so hand off a bag. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 (do his Payday Loans jobs first). The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, and each pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat zone (or reach a Pay 'n' Spray). The easiest way is the first bank vault job — That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4) — since robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and you need all 8 vaults for 100% anyway. To get it earlier: box in an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open, and get away. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.guide: Per PowerPyx: after you get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City, hack into it, and drive it straight through the showroom window. trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling — take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs to blow it). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You don't need all three in one visit: if you miss one, the robbery respawns after a long time and you can go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check it in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength). Work out at fitness clubs — filter the map by Activities — and always bring your partner along (hold Right, then Triangle to call them): while you train with one character, the other completes their training too, so you make double progress. Available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; after the story you can also train at home.

It comes naturally from robberies and encounters while you work on everything else. Don't push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes police more aggressive.
